Nina (RevOps): Quick sync — spikes in enrichment latency are causing churn in claim ownership. Leads assigned at ingest, then enrichment update triggers a second assignment. Looking to smooth this.
Tom (Growth): How noisy is it? Numbers please.
Nina (RevOps): Peak window ~150 leads/hr, ~6-9% get reassigned within 45s. Causes churn notifications and lost context.
Ravi (Sales Ops): Reassigned leads show as "new" in SF and ping AEs. We need to reduce false-new events.
Jordan (Eng-Data): Proposal: implement a short "claim smoothing" window: when initial assign happens within X seconds of ingest and enrichment is pending, mark lead as "smoothing_hold" for Y seconds and suppress reassign attempts.
Lily (Marketing Ops): Y should be configurable by pool. For VIP / SQL pools, small (5-8s). For inbound cold pools, 25-40s ok.
Nina (RevOps): Suggested defaults: VIP=8s, standard=30s, overflow fallback TTL=10m. Also store original_claimant in metadata for audit.
Jordan (Eng-Data): Pseudo-code:
```
# routing handler
if lead.enrichment_status == 'pending' and now - lead.ingest_ts < pool_config.smoothing_window:
  lead.props.rd_smoothing_hold = true
  record_metric('lead.smoothing.hold', pool=pool)
  return // wait for enrichment or ttl
else:
  claim_owner(lead, pool)
```
Tom (Growth): Can we avoid putting leads into the unassigned backlog while held? The UI shows them as unowned.
Ravi (Sales Ops): Yes, need to ensure HS owner remains blank but with a property `rd_expected_claim` so AEs see a note.
Lily (Marketing Ops): How about a small ephemeral Slack note for VIP holds: "VIP lead being enriched — expect ownership in a few seconds". Not a full alert, just a passive message.
hs-sync-bot: Will ignore HS updates when `rd_smoothing_hold=true` and will not push duplicate owner updates.
Jordan (Eng-Data): Metrics & observability: add `lead.smoothing.hold.count`, `lead.reassign.30s.rate`, `lead.enrichment.latency.p95`. Dashboards and a Grafana alert if reassign rate > 4%.
Nina (RevOps): Rollout idea: feature-flagged canary 5% ingest -> 20% -> 100% with 24-48h observation windows. If we see increased "unassigned_after_ttl" events, rollback.
Tom (Growth): Also add an event tracing field: `claim_history` (append-only string) so we can query what happened in sequence without joining events.
Jordan (Eng-Data): We'll append small entries like `t=1726009999 action=hold by=router` — kept as string to avoid schema churn.
Ravi (Sales Ops): Important: if enrichment fails or takes >TTL, fallback to overflow pool and set `rd_smoothing_reason=timeout`.
Lily (Marketing Ops): Messaging: update AE handoffs doc to say "temporary holds may delay initial assignment by up to 30s while enrichment runs — metadata will show hold reason". I'll draft copy.
Nina (RevOps): Action items: 1) Jordan adds metrics + backfill (ETA EOD) 2) Eng implements smoothing flag + pool-configurable window (ETA 48h) 3) hs-sync-bot change to ignore rd_smoothing_hold (Jordan + hs team) (ETA 24h) 4) Lily drafts AE messaging and slack snippet (ETA tomorrow morning).
Jordan (Eng-Data): I'll also create a short SQL to pull hold counts by pool:
```sql
SELECT pool, count(*) as holds
FROM lead_events
WHERE event = 'smoothing_hold' AND ts >= now() - interval '7 days'
GROUP BY pool;
```
Ravi (Sales Ops): Please capture `previous_owner` when reassign happens so we can compute churn rate by AE.
Nina (RevOps): Yes — will include `previous_owner` and `claim_reason` in the reassignment payload.
Tom (Growth): This is a good story for the next AE webinar — explain how we reduced false-new notifications and tightened SLA guarantees. I'll prep a slide.
Lily (Marketing Ops): One more UX idea: in the HubSpot contact card show a tiny badge: "Pending enrichment — ownership held". Low friction and reduces pings.
Jordan (Eng-Data): Noted. We'll add HS property `rd_smoothing_hold=true` and `rd_expected_claim_eta` with seconds. hs-sync-bot will surface that in contact view.
Nina (RevOps): Canary monitoring thresholds: if smoothing_holds/hr > 700 or reassign_30s_rate > 5% -> auto-alert. Jordan please add dashboards.
Jordan (Eng-Data): On it. Backfill job scheduled for tomorrow to understand baseline.
Lily (Marketing Ops): Thanks team — ping me when messaging copy is ready.
Nina (RevOps): Thanks everyone. I'll open the rollout RFC and tag eng and hs-sync.
